summary: Iteration 36 tested new practice-filter backend matching/validation plus 45s/30s RTC countdown behavior, then ran mobile-first call UI checks (filter sheet + top ringing cards) with two QA accounts.

minor.issue: Country filter positive-match assertion was skipped in automated run because QA2 profile had no country value to match against; invalid-value 422 checks still passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent web/mobile rendering issue: in one reproducible run, filter sheet opened with geometry far below viewport (sheet top ~747 at vh 667) and country picker became untappable (Element is outside viewport). In another run it rendered correctly and Apply worked.

integration_issues.issue: Flow is flaky in automation: sometimes works and applies, sometimes picker taps fail due off-viewport sheet position in same build.

action_items: Stabilize CallFilterSheet web positioning/open sequence (likely modal+KAV/animation timing race) so picker rows are always in viewport and tappable.
For deterministic QA, set/seed country metadata on at least one approved QA profile so country filter positive-match checks can always be executed.
Re-run full filter interaction regression after sheet positioning fix (country/native/chips + backdrop discard + reset/apply clear).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend target features tested in this iteration passed: direct-call re-checks stored availability filters, random match enforces both sides' preferences, /rtc/calls and random reserve return authoritative expires_at, 45s no-answer and 30s connecting timeouts broadcast call_end.
Minor API hygiene: use-practice-calls currently builds partner URL with trailing '&' when no filters are active (`...partners?language=all&`); functional but noisy.

success_rate.backend: 83% (5 passed / 1 skipped in iteration36 target suite)
success_rate.frontend: 85% (ringing UX accept/reject/cancel/timeout + top card countdown passed; filter sheet interaction is flaky)

seed_data_creation: No new accounts created. No DB seeds added. QA profiles restored for edited language fields in backend tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not assume filter sheet broken globally: single-context probe at 390x667 showed correct geometry and clickable Apply, but multi-step/mobile runs intermittently rendered sheet/picker off-viewport. Ringing UX is stable: outgoing/incoming top cards show countdown, no full controls pre-accept, accept opens call controls, reject/cancel/timeout close both overlays.
rca_of_issue: Likely frontend race condition in filter modal positioning on web (modal open while state/loading/layout animation in progress). Repro pattern: open /call, trigger filters quickly in longer scripted flow; picker tap fails with outside-viewport error and geometry reports sheet below viewport. Mitigation during testing: wait until filter button enabled and use isolated single-context open; this reduced failure but did not remove intermittent behavior.
